name: orquestador-plus
description: Centro de mando personal para desarrolladores: tareas, bugs, notas y bitácora, local y sin conexión.
author: Javo38841

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ng,electron-build,electron -c cyan,magenta,green "ng serve --host 127.0.0.1" "node scripts/build-electron.mjs --watch" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:4200 dist/main/main.js dist/preload/preload.js && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4200 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.spec.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.test: npm run test:main && npm run test:renderer
scripts.test:main: cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.main.config.mts
